title: OtterBox Galaxy S25+ Defender XT Case - Purple

Denver Dusk purple clear Defender Series Pro XT with Magnets for Galaxy S25+; same purple clear Mag variant as Woot/Violet Thunder

writeup: Woot has a new OtterBox Defender XT clear Mag case for Galaxy S25+ in purple (Violet Thunder / Denver Dusk, retail MPN 77-97583) for $9.99. OtterBox's site currently lists the same purple clear Mag Defender Series Pro XT with magnets at $48.99, and Best Buy has it at $64.99. That is 79 percent and about $39 below OtterBox. Quantity is 3+ left, with a limit of 3 per customer.
